name: RC-B10-0143/2026 – After § 5 – Am 22
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on four years of Russia’s war of aggression against Ukraine and European contributions to a just peace and sustained security for Ukraine
part_text: 5. Welcomes the adoption of the law that will allow Orthodox parishes from Ukraine to disaffiliate from the jurisdiction of the Moscow Patriarchate and to decide freely onto their new hierarchical affiliation; notes that, in August 2024, Romanian Orthodox parishes in Ukraine submitted a request for the recognition of the ‘Romanian Orthodox Church in Ukraine’ as a religious association, so that Romanian Orthodox parishes disaffiliating from the jurisdiction of the Moscow Patriarchate could affiliate with it;
